guidance: Project skills live in `.claude/skills/`; personal skills live in `~/.claude/skills`. Project skills require a trusted repository. Use `/skills` to inspect them and `/orqivra-orchestrate`, `/orqivra-architecture`, `/orqivra-verify`, or `/orqivra-recover` to invoke one; matching natural-language requests may also activate a skill. The profile advises Sonnet 5.5 for routine roles and Opus 5.5 for complex work; Fable 5.1 is opt-in. Select a model with `/model` or `claude --model`; ORQIVRA does not switch active sessions. No effort override is set because current docs differ on Sonnet 5.5's default; the client decides unless `config show` supplies a supported control. Claude Code may switch models for availability or safety fallback; ORQIVRA cannot disable it. Permissions and tool rules remain authoritative. Skill activation grants no permission: do not bypass prompts, and stop and report denied or unavailable actions.
